newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat closes higher on mill buying.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat closes higher on mill buying.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed higher on mill buying but gains were trimmed by a late break in the CBOT soybean market, traders said.
"There was another round of mill buying but it was focused on the deferred months," a trader said.
Atwood Larson and Cargill Investor Services each bought at least one half million bushels of May, traders said.
An increase in producer selling limited gains in the May contract, the traders said.
"There's movement in the country which is why the spread is backing off," a trader said.
Traders also said talk continues about some concern about the heavy snowpack in the spring wheat growing region which could delay seeding of the spring wheat crop.
MGE spring wheat futures closed 1/4 to three cents higher, with March up three at $4.28 a bushel. May was up 1/4 cent at $4.00-3/4.
MGE barley closed five cents lower to one higher, with March unchanged at $6.75 per cwt.
